mode: real DSH DeepSeek API main agent and real native child, isolated Git/SQLite/Host

agent.prompt: Coordinate a durable plan, parallel independent developers and exact-commit acceptance. Do not claim success before workflow_finish succeeds.

request.content: Run a bounded acceptance of the RIFT workflow tools. Start a workflow with goal "Read the acceptance README without changing files". Submit exactly one analysis task, assigned to developer-a, with expectedPaths [] and acceptance criteria ["Read README.md; change no file and make no commit"]. Ask the child to return the required RIFT result JSON with outcome completed, summary confirming the README title, changedPaths [], checksClaimed [], blockingReasons []. Dispatch it using current versions. Wait for the actual registered child result; inspect status and finish the workflow only after the analysis task succeeds and cleanup is confirmed. Do not create change tasks or edit files. Once rift_workflow_finish succeeds, reply RIFT_NATIVE_WORKFLOW_OK. If blocked, explain the exact tool error and stop.
